payload.definition: Tracks the material presence and accessibility of coffee in workplaces and society. Includes supply levels, rationing systems, substitutes, and black market activity.
payload.inclusion_criteria: Apply when text explicitly discusses coffee supply, availability, access, or absence. Includes hoarding behaviors, rationing policies, supplier issues, and alternative beverages tried as replacements.
payload.exclusion_criteria: Do not apply to subjective feelings about coffee (use emotional codes). Do not apply to effects of no coffee (use embodied codes). This is purely about material conditions of supply.
examples: rationing last week - two cups per person
Nobody brings coffee anymore - it does not exist
